label_definitions.ON: sub-problem queries address the described difficulty in the right scientific sense
label_definitions.PARTIAL: right field, but a different facet or a mis-framing of the difficulty
label_definitions.DRIFT: plausible-sounding queries in the wrong field or the wrong sense of a term
label_definitions.FILLER: generic boilerplate or literal template placeholders not tied to the description

protocol: Single annotator, by reading the stored LLM-generated query lists; one label per sub-problem (a group of 3 queries). Only the 15 stored disagreement records (13 distinct examples) were annotated; these are not a random sample.
